newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen ends down in Tokyo on Kampo report.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen ends down in Tokyo on Kampo report.

text.p: The key June three-month Euroyen contract ended easier on Monday, due to a news agency report that Japan's Postal Life Insurance Bureau, called Kampo, is getting wary of more government bond purchases, traders said.

"We cannot help but become cautious of making additional purchases of instruments such as JGBs," the report quoted an official with the Fund Management Division of the Post Office Life Insurance Bureau as saying.
